versions.subject: Create win_susp_rpcping
versions.detection:
use_rpcping:
    Image|endswith: '\rpcping.exe'
remote_server:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '-s'
        - '/s'
ntlm_auth:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '-u NTLM'
        - '/u NTLM'
        - 't ncacn_np'
condition: use_rpcping and remote_server and ntlm_auth
versions.spl: Image="*\\rpcping.exe" CommandLine IN ("*-s*", "*/s*") CommandLine IN ("*-u NTLM*", "*/u NTLM*", "*t ncacn_np*")
